title: A Globally Convergent Variational Framework for Mode Number Detection via Spectral Cutting Curves
summary: Automatically determining the number of intrinsic mode functions (IMFs) and their center frequencies in Variational Mode Decomposition (VMD) remains an open mathematical challenge. Existing methods rely on heuristic settings, trial-and-error, or recursive extraction lacking theoretical convergence guarantees. We propose a variational framework that endogenously determines the number of modes. Any curve below the spectral amplitude divides the area under the spectrum into 2 parts and generate the connected intervals where spectrum locates above it, whose count defines the modal number K[g] --…
